ruleDefinitions.name: Local accounts were enumerated - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Enumerating Linux account information can aid an attacker in directing his attacks against certain users. Exabeam has identified commands that extract this type of account information.

sequences.query: vendor: "Unix" AND (activity_type: "process-create" AND (process_command_line: ("who ", "last ", "whoami ", "finger ", "pink ", "users ", "logname ") OR (process_command_line: ("lslogins ") AND NOT process_command_line: ("rmdir"))))
